purpose: Source inventory for the first eastern Mediterranean / Near East map expansion.

countries.name: Italy
countries.notes: ADM2 exposes Italy's 20 regions, which is good gameplay-scale raw geometry and avoids a one-off Natural Earth import.

countries.name: Greece
countries.notes: ADM2 gives 14 useful raw units; retain high detail around Attica, central Greece, Peloponnese, Macedonia, Crete and Aegean islands.

countries.name: Turkey / Anatolia
countries.notes: 81 modern provinces are raw pieces only; merge into historical/game-geographic Anatolian regions.

countries.name: Cyprus
countries.notes: Major copper source; likely merge six districts into 2-4 game regions.

countries.name: Syria
countries.notes: Useful basis for Ugarit coast, Orontes/northern Syria and inland regions.

countries.name: Lebanon
countries.notes: Small modern units; merge into a few coastal/hinterland game regions.

countries.name: Israel
countries.notes: ADM2 gives 15 subdistricts. Use geometry as ingredients for Canaan/Philistia/Galilee regions, not modern political gameplay boundaries.

countries.name: Palestine
countries.notes: ADM2 gives 16 governorates. Combine with neighbouring source geometry for historically meaningful southern Levant regions.

countries.name: Jordan
countries.notes: Merge governorates into a small number of Transjordan/desert-edge regions.

countries.name: Egypt
countries.notes: Keep Nile Delta and valley detailed; merge large desert governorates aggressively.

countries.name: Iraq / Mesopotamia
countries.notes: Build Upper Mesopotamia, Assyria and Babylonian south from governorate polygons.

countries.name: Iran
countries.notes: Only western/southwestern provinces needed initially for Elam/Zagros/eastern Mesopotamian fringe. Current source reports 33 units but downloaded 32 with duplicated Mazandaran; validate before integration.

countries.name: Libya
countries.notes: Prioritise Mediterranean coast; very large Saharan regions.

countries.name: Tunisia
countries.notes: Useful central Mediterranean/North African continuation.

countries.name: Algeria
countries.notes: Mostly coastal belt for this phase; deep Sahara low resolution.

countries.name: Albania
countries.notes: Southern Balkan land corridor into Greece.

countries.name: North Macedonia
countries.notes: Southern Balkan interior corridor.

countries.name: Bulgaria
countries.notes: Thrace and Balkan corridor; merge modern provinces substantially.

countries.name: Serbia
countries.notes: Danube/Balkan interior connection.

countries.name: Montenegro
countries.notes: Adriatic/Balkan connector; likely one or two game regions.

countries.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
countries.notes: ADM1 is only the three modern constitutional entities; ADM2 provides 12 more useful raw pieces.

countries.name: Croatia
countries.notes: Adriatic coast and northern Balkan link toward Italy.

countries.name: Armenia
countries.notes: Useful later for eastern Anatolia/Caucasus metal and migration routes.

countries.name: Georgia
countries.notes: Useful later for Caucasus fringe and Black Sea links.
